_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 0% base rate for ±2+ point moves across 36 windows screams coil — HOLD is the statistically honest call; a directional UP claim requires seeing the breaker (MVRV lift + funding cool) which has not arrived.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see bottom-accumulation structure, but analyst forward calls HOLD while narrative leans directional re-pricing; judge sides with analyst's HOLD given 0% base rate and analyst's higher trust weight
next_move.confirmed_if: MVRV_zscore rises above 30 with BTC holding $62k and funding dropping below 40
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks $58k with exchange_netflow spiking above 75 and VIX pushing past 80
